document:
Exercise: Close-Grip Push-Up off of a Dumbbell

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- push

Primary Muscles:

- triceps

Secondary Muscles:

- abdominals
- chest
- shoulders

Equipment:

- bodyweight

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:
None

Contraindications:

- Individuals with shoulder or elbow injuries should avoid this exercise or modify it under professional supervision.
- Those with wrist issues may find this exercise uncomfortable and should consider alternatives.

Exercise Variations:

- name: Wide-Grip Close-Grip Push-Up, description: Widen the grip on the dumbbell to target different parts of the triceps.
- name: Close-Grip Push-Up with Dumbbell in Front, description: Place the dumbbell in front of you and perform the push-up, focusing on the lower part of the triceps.

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Incline Dumbbell Push-Up, equipment: dumbbells
- exercise_name: Close-Grip Bench Press, equipment: barbell

Instructions:

- Lie on the floor and place your hands on an upright dumbbell. Supporting your weight on your toes and hands, keep your torso rigid and your elbows in with your arms straight. This will be your starting position.
- Lower your body, allowing the elbows to flex while you inhale. Keep your body straight, not allowing your hips to rise or sag.
- Press yourself back up to the starting position by extending the elbows. Breathe out as you perform this step.
- After a pause at the contracted position, repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
